title: Engineering a Dual-Functional Bacterium for Petroleum Hydrocarbon Degradation and Carbon Fixation via glnQ-Mediated Metabolism
description: Whole Genome Sequencing Analysis of Bacillus cereus S10. This study aims to explore the genomic structural characteristics of Bacillus cereus S10 through whole-genome sequencing technology, systematically analyze its potential functional genes related to petroleum hydrocarbon degradation and carbon assimilation metabolic pathways, and thus clarify the degradation mechanism of petroleum hydrocarbon pollutants and carbon source utilization capacity of this strain at the molecular level. The results will provide genomic evidence for further exploring its application potential in the field of environmental pollutant bioremediation.
center: State Key Laboratory of Petroleum Pollution Control
